audience: sales teams that track leads, contacts and tasks in Nutshell CRM

useCases.title: Review open leads and their value
useCases.text: List leads with their value, status and pipeline stage. Open one lead to see its links to products, contacts and tags.

useCases.title: Look up contacts and read the notes
useCases.text: List contacts with their email, phone and company. Read the notes attached to a lead, contact or account.

useCases.title: Review tasks and recent activities
useCases.text: List tasks, filtered by assignee or date. List the calls, meetings and emails between users and contacts.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task for a lead
useCases.text: Find the user who will own the follow-up. Create a task linked to the lead and assigned to that user.

useCases.title: Close a lead as won or lost
useCases.text: List the outcomes, such as won or lost. Close the lead with an outcome, and add a note with the reason.
